courses.name: SIA Licence
courses.detail: Door Supervisor, Security Officer and CCTV Operator courses plus refreshers at centres across the UK.

courses.name: NEBOSH & IOSH
courses.detail: The go-to qualifications for health and safety advisor roles. Online, virtual or classroom.

courses.name: Fire Risk Assessment (Level 3–4)
courses.detail: FireQual Level 3 Certificate in Foundation Fire Risk Assessment (to BS 8674), with a Level 4 Intermediate course as the next step. Most fire risk assessor adverts ask for Level 3 or 4.

courses.name: Counter Fraud Investigator
courses.detail: Usually around 24 months and often paid for by the employer.

courses.name: IT Support certificate
courses.detail: Beginner-friendly, self-paced. A common first step into IT and helpdesk jobs.

courses.name: AI Essentials & AI Professional
courses.detail: Learn to use AI tools at work. No experience needed.

courses.name: Cybersecurity certificate
courses.detail: Entry-level cyber skills. Investigators and digital forensics staff have a head start.

courses.name: Data Analytics certificate
courses.detail: Spreadsheets, data and dashboards for analyst roles.

courses.name: Excel, Word & Microsoft 365
courses.detail: Free video training from Microsoft to brush up the Excel, Word and Outlook skills every civilian job expects.

courses.name: Plumbing & heating
courses.detail: New-career plumbing courses for adult changers: online theory then practical centre training, from Level 2 Diploma up to NVQ and ACS.

courses.name: Electrician
courses.detail: Beginners domestic electrician course covering Part P, 18th Edition and Building Regulations.

courses.name: Gas engineer
courses.detail: New-entrant gas engineer programmes leading to ACS and Gas Safe registration (Glasgow, Edinburgh, Liverpool and Manchester centres).

courses.name: Award in Education & Training
courses.detail: Level 3 award studied online with a tutor; enrol any time. Needed to teach first aid, conflict management and to run most training franchises.

courses.name: First aid instructor
courses.detail: 5-day first aid instructor course including the Level 3 Award in Education and Training, so you can teach first aid at work courses.

courses.name: Driving Instructor (ADI)
courses.detail: Training with a place in their franchise once you qualify.

courses.name: HGV licence
courses.detail: Free HGV training of up to 16 weeks through Skills Bootcamps in England, for adults 19+ with a car licence.

courses.name: Project management (APM PFQ)
courses.detail: Beginner-level Project Fundamentals Qualification: about 25 hours of study and a one-hour exam you can sit at home.

courses.name: PRINCE2 7 Foundation
courses.detail: The widely asked-for project management certificate: 60-question, 60-minute exam.
